result.title: When the Proxy Is Wrong: Mismatch-Corrected Bandits for Adaptive Data Sampling
result.summary: Data allocation methods often use a small proxy model to select training data for a larger target model. However, this proxy can rank data differently from the target, leading to suboptimal training performance. To address this problem, we model the mismatch between the proxy and target models and incorporate it into the allocation decision. To do so, the problem is cast as a multi-fidelity bandit, where each arm is a data intervention. The proxy reward is observed every round, whereas the target reward is revealed only on rare audits of the same update. These paired observations identify arm-wise mismatches without assuming a shared offset or preservation of rankings. Mismatch-corrected bandits correct the proxy with paired residuals, audit only uncertain decisions, and pace the audit budget over training. From a theoretical viewpoint, we prove a regret decomposition and lower bounds under stationarity. These bounds show that proxy-only allocation can incur linear regret and that a minimum number of paired audits is necessary. Under abrupt changes, using the audit budget early can also incur linear regret. A sliding-window policy that spreads audits over training achieves regret of order $\sqrt{Γ_T T\log T}$ where $Γ_T$ denotes the number of change points. Experimentally, we test the approach in a closed-loop proof of concept on CivilComments-WILDS, where BERT-Small guides the training of BERT-Large. Mismatch correction improves worst-group accuracy over a target-only policy with the same target-model budget. Spreading audits over training improves worst-group accuracy by 6.3 to 10.5 percentage points at the same audit count.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把「小代理模型为大模型挑选训练数据时排序不一致」的问题建模为多保真 bandit：用配对残差校正代理奖励，仅在不确定决策上花审计预算，并给出 regret 分解与下界；在 CivilComments-WILDS 上用 BERT-Small 指导 BERT-Large 训练，提升最差组准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 代理奖励与真实目标奖励不一致、以及「廉价代理每轮可得、昂贵真值仅稀缺审计」的预算分配，可能为 LVR 中如何选择性投入昂贵验证、如何校正代理信号下的贡献分配提供可核查线索；但原文面向训练数据采样而非 latent 推理状态，迁移性需自行判断。
